Russian President Vladimir Putin has signed a decree boosting the size of the army by 15,500 troops in the fourth such order this year.

ADVERTISEMENT
"The authorised personnel strength of the Russian armed forces is to be set at 2,441,630 units, including 1,550,500 military personnel," the decree said.
Putin had previously signed documents boosting the size of the army in March, June and July. The combined increase since March amounts to 47,860 soldiers.
The president did not state the reason for the decision, but it has been taken against the backdrop of rising losses on both the Russian and Ukrainian sides in the full-scale war in Ukraine.

Poland says Russian military helicopter violated its airspace
September 23, 2026, 3:04 pm
Source: Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces
A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter entered Polish airspace on September 23 at 11:08 a.m., the operational command of the Polish army said.
The helicopter, flying from the Kaliningrad region, crossed about 300 meters (984 feet) into Polish airspace and remained there for 42 seconds, the Polish military said.
Poland scrambled fighter jets and put ground forces and equipment on alert. “The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense,” the command said.
Russia has not yet commented on the incident.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on September 17 that Russia is planning “hybrid” strikes using missiles and drones against countries that support Ukraine. He claimed that “there is a real risk that drones or other types of missiles may fly into the territory of one or more NATO countries on the eastern flank, even cause destruction.”

Tsahkna said the security cabinet regularly discusses potential Russian actions and how Estonia should respond, adding that a general mobilization would significantly increase domestic tensions in Russia.

The five men arrested on suspicion of terror offences near RAF Fairford on Sunday have been released on bail, according to the head of UK counter terrorism policing.
The men, UK nationals in their 20s, were arrested under the Explosives Act and on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act.
Speaking to the press on Monday, Assistant Commissioner Laurence Taylor said the investigation was not over as police are considering numerous angles, including if proxies working on behalf of a foreign state could have been involved.

Nemecký minister Johann Wadephul po stretnutí s Lavrovom odmieta ďalšie rokovania s Moskvou bez zmeny jej postoja. Hovorí o potrebe tvrdšieho tlaku na Rusko.
Nemecký minister zahraničných vecí Johann Wadephul, ktorý sa cez víkend v New Yorku stretol so svojím ruským náprotivkom Sergejom Lavrovom, aspoň zatiaľ nevidí dôvod na ďalšie rokovania s predstaviteľmi Ruska. Uviedol to v pondelok počas návštevy Holandska, píše TASR podľa správy agentúry DPA.
„Ďalšie stretnutia majú zmysel len za predpokladu, že Rusko je skutočne pripravené rokovať,“ povedal Wadephul, ktorý sa s Lavrovom stretol na 20 minút na okraj Valného zhromaždenia OSN. Hlavnou témou ich rozhovoru bola vojna na Ukrajine, ktorá sa od februára 2022 bráni invázii ruských jednotiek. Išlo o prvé…

Všech pět podezřelých, kteří byli v neděli zadrženi u západoanglické základny RAF Fairford využívané americkým letectvem, jsou britští občané žijící v Londýně. Britské úřady v pondělí nadále zadržovaly pětici zatčených mužů a zkoumaly podezřelé výbušniny nalezené poblíž letecké základny provozované USA, zatímco protiterorističtí vyšetřovatelé zjišťovali, zda se díky těmto zatčením podařilo zmařit útok napojený na Írán, píše agentura AP.
U základny, odkud vzlétaly americké…

To date, the main focus in establishing a network of bomb shelters in Latvia has been on identifying and adapting the basements of existing state and local authority buildings. One of the next steps involves industrially manufactured shelters. The Ministry of Economics is currently preparing standard documentation for the procurement of such shelters, Latvian Radio reported on September 28.
Industrially manufactured shelters could be either above-ground or underground, and could be purchased by local authorities and other institutions in places where there are no suitable cellars or where adapting them would be too complicated. The Ministry of Economics (EM) has promised to draw up standardised documentation for the procurement of such shelters by the start of October.

Fears are growing that Moscow could use the sprawling Arctic archipelago — a part of Norway with an unusual legal status — to test NATO militarily amid growing uncertainty over the U.S. commitment to European defense.
Allies suspect Russia of probing crucial undersea cables in the waters off Svalbard and staging military-style events that test the limits of the rules governing its presence there. Podle ukrajinského serveru, který se odvolává na úřady, byl dronový útok z noci na neděli třetím dnem útoků na ukrajinskou metropoli po sobě. V Ševčenkivské čtvrti podle Klyčka dron zasáhl obytnou budovu, která však byla neobydlená. Její požár dostali hasiči pod kontrolu.

Just a few months ago, Russia's war was an distant reality for many people in Europe outside of Ukraine. At most, there was discussion of hybrid warfare.
The situation has changed radically since the summer. Nový ukrajinský robotický systém Desantnyk Video: Brave1
Článek
Robotický systém vytvořili příslušníci pluku Alter Ego z 93. samostatné mechanizované brigády. Technologie umožňuje vysadit pozemního robota desítky kilometrů za nepřátelskou linii pomocí bezpilotního letounu.
„Systém, ve kterém jeden dron dopravuje druhý do oblasti operací, se nazývá „marsupial“ (česky vačnatec). Podobná řešení vyvíjeli před třiceti lety ve Spojených státech, nikdy je ale nevyužili v boji,“ cituje server iniciativu Brave1.
Kromě samotného Desantnyku iniciativa vyvinula také řešení, jak je přesně svrhnout z bombardovacího dronu. Podle Brave1 od nápadu…

At least one person has died and five more are missing after an explosion destroyed a building in the historic centre of Athens.
The blast happened in the Plaka area of the Greek capital, a neighbourhood close to tourist sites such as the Acropolis, with local media reporting the building housed a holiday rental.
Four American tourists, one British national and a Greek national are said to the people involved - though that has not been confirmed by authorities.
Pictures from the scene showed emergency service workers searching through the rubble, with a gas leak suspected as the cause of the blast.
The body of a woman was found on Saturday morning, with the search ongoing.
The tourists were confirmed to be missing when they did not arrive for their flight at Athens airport, Reuters news agency reported citing local police.

Rusko a Ukrajina pokračovaly ve vzájemných dronových útocích. Ukrajinské síly zaútočily v noci z pátku na sobotu na ropnou rafinerii v Ilsku v ruském Krasnodarském kraji. Podle generálního štábu ukrajinských sil na místě vypukl požár. Rafinerie byla cílem útoků Ukrajinců již dříve. Ruské údery hlásí i Ukrajina, kde podle úřadů zemřelo nejméně šest lidí. Zasaženo bylo také datové centrum v Kyjevě.
Generální štáb podle serveru Ukrajinska pravda uvedl, že ropná rafinerie v Ilsku má zpracovatelskou kapacitu přibližně 6,6 milionu tun ropy ročně. Ruské úřady zásah rafinerie nepotvrdily. Podle ukrajinských a ruských telegramových kanálů byla zasažena také Afipská rafinerie. Útok podle ruských úřadů narušil…

Damage caused by Russia at the Starokozache international border crossing. Stock photo: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine
The Ministry for Recovery, Infrastructure and Transport is preparing an agreement that will allow Ukrainian border and customs services to operate on Polish territory.
Source: a report by the Ministry for Recovery following a meeting with the Polish side at the Yahodyn-Dorohusk border crossing.
Details: The meeting was attended by heads of Polish voivodeships, representatives of Poland's Ministry of the Interior and Ministry of Finance, as well as border and customs service officials from both countries.

One of the main areas discussed at the meeting was the development of joint border crossing points and joint controls on the Ukrainian-Polish border.
Joint control means that the Ukrainian and Polish border and customs services carry out the necessary procedures at a single…

By Jessica Parker Berlin correspondent
Published
26 September 2026
A set of bumper local elections has thrown Germany, and its government, off balance.
Chancellor Friedrich Merz may now be a man on borrowed time. His coalition government is in crisis.
But this breakdown of business as usual in Germany has been brewing for years.
It's a nation wrestling with new, uncomfortable and unresolved realities.
Think of certain stereotypes about Germany, and think again.
A country dominated by boring, consensus-driven politics? Not any more.
A confident, powerhouse economy at the cutting edge of car-making? Yesterday's story.
A nation that can be used as a byword for impressive efficiency? The trains don't even run on time.
Many Germans I've spoken to feel their nation has drifted away from the things that once anchored their identity.
And the question of what next is, as yet, unanswered.
That uncertainty is currently embodied by a beleaguered chancellor weakened by bruising regional election results.

Soldiers from the 16 Air Assault Brigade set up a mortar firing position after parachuting from a British Royal Air Force A400M transport aircraft onto Salisbury Plain at the Copehill Down training facility near Warminster, England, on March 30, 2026. (Finnbarr Webster/Getty Images)
Europe Prefer on Google
by Martin Fornusek
Moscow's shadow war on Europe grows bolder by the day, and no one can say how far the Kremlin is ready to go.
Russia is no longer only meddling in elections or hacking networks: Germany found explosives-laden drones at its Leipzig Airport in an apparent Moscow-backed sabotage plot . Russian drone incursions in NATO airspace are now common . And a Russian warship shot flares at a Danish military helicopter.
The rhetoric in Western capitals has hardened, with some saying this campaign is " no longer hybrid at all ."
For the first time, Berlin named Russia as a perpetrator of a physical attack against its infrastructure, and allies grow less fearful…

Under veckan har Försvarsmakten genomfört en omfattande övning i och kring Övertorneå centralort. Bron över till Finland har blivit extra viktig att skydda efter Sveriges inträde i Nato – och när SVT är på plats säkras bron mot möjliga sabotage.
Gränsjägarbataljonen, även kallad 11:e hemvärnsbataljonen, genomför just nu sin krigsförbandsövning, KFÖ – en obligatorisk övning för alla som är engagerade i förbandet.

– Det här är ett av de viktigaste områdena i Sverige att försvara, säger bataljonschef L-G Lundström.

Russian political scientist and election analyst Alexander Kynev arrested in Moscow on drug charges
September 25, 2026, 11:56 am
Source: Mediazona
Moscow’s Perovsky District Court ordered the arrest of political scientist Alexander Kynev on September 25 in a drug case, the independent Russian news outlet Mediazona reported, citing court records and defense attorney Mikhail Biryukov.
Kynev is accused of producing, selling, or shipping illegal drugs on a large scale, a charge that carries a prison sentence of 10 to 20 years. No further details about the case have been disclosed.
It is unknown when Kynev was detained, though he had continued posting on his Telegram channel about election results up until recently. His last post appeared on September 23.
Alexander Kynev is a political scientist who studies the structure of power in Russia’s regions and analyzes election results at the regional and federal levels. Russian authorities designated Kynev a foreign agent in February.

Av domen framgår att mannen har erkänt de flesta av gärningarna. I några fall uppger han att han inte minns riktigt vad som har hänt.
I tingsrätten har mannen berättat att han under perioder har mått psykiskt dåligt till följd av en anhörigs sjukdom. På nätterna har han åkt runt i bil och upplevt någon form av lindring när han har förstört saker. Han har också haft ett viss agg mot en fiberleverantör.

A priest has been killed and four other people injured in a knife attack in south-east Poland, officials have said.
A 31-year-old Ukrainian man was arrested after the stabbings on the grounds of a Catholic abbey in the town of Jarosław.
Polish President Karol Nawrocki said Thursday's attack "has shaken us all and demands a firm response from the state", while his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky said "we are shocked by this evil".
Reports in Polish media said the attacker first injured a priest in a nearby cafe, and then another four people inside the abbey itself. A police investigation into the attacker's motives is now under way.
Polish police said four men and one woman were stabbed in the attack on Thursday morning on the abbey grounds.
The name of the murdered priest has not been publicly released.
Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said psychological support was now being provided to all those affected by the incident.

Článek
Ruské útoky na Západ a NATO budou podle dánské zpravodajské služby v nadcházejících měsících častější a „pro zasažené země budou mít větší následky než v minulosti“, uvádí agentura Reuters .
Rovněž podle dánské analýzy hrozeb existuje „nízké, ale rostoucí riziko“, že Rusko spustí omezený vojenský útok proti jednomu nebo několika státům NATO, které s ním sousedí.
„Omezený vojenský útok by ze strany Ruska byl zoufalým tahem a stejně jako zesílené hybridní útoky by se mohl odehrát v následujících měsících,“ stojí ve zprávě dánské zpravodajské služby.

Starlink ground station catches fire near Warsaw. Polish security services suspect Russian sabotage.
September 24, 2026, 2:50 pm
Source: RMF24
A Starlink satellite communications ground station caught fire on the evening of September 23 in the village of Wola Krobowska, in Poland’s Masovian Voivodeship, less than 50 kilometers (31 miles) from Warsaw.
The fire destroyed the distribution panel that connects to the station’s antennas.
Polish security services believe the fire was the result of arson, RMF24 reported. Sources said a bottle of flammable liquid resembling a “Molotov cocktail” was found near the distribution panel.
Polish Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said that “wherever suspicious fires occur, we must by default assume that we are dealing with possible sabotage or subversion.” He said Russia “is using fairly simple methods — they carry out arson attacks and acts of sabotage, provoking social instability across Europe.”

Guten Tag! A také Привет. Navštívila jsem Ruský dům v Berlíně, který je už léta objektem podezření ze špionáže.
Ministr zahraničních věcí Johann Wadephul začátkem září oznámil, že smlouva Německa s Ruskem, na jejímž základě je provozován, bude vypovězena. Jde o jedno z několika opatření přijatých jako odvetná reakce na ruskou účast v  pokusu o dronový útok na letišti Lipsko/Halle .
Nicméně, jak jsem na místě zjistila, lidé se tam pořád pohybují a do příštího léta to nebude jinak.
Je velmi těžké Ruský dům nespatřit: nachází se v srdci německého hlavního města, na nákupní ulici Friedrichstraße.
Budova, která byla v roce 1984 v NDR navržena jako Dům sovětské vědy a kultury, je opravdu gigantická: má osm pater s plochou 29 000 metrů čtverečních; uvnitř se nachází foyer o rozloze 1700 metrů čtverečních, obchodní prostory, výstavní prostory a několik divadelních sálů, 64 bytů a vnitřní nádvoří s parkovacími místy.
Pouze socha Lenina z osmdesátých let, obklopená palmami a stojící před schodištěm,…

To ensure that cargoes stolen in Ukraine, including grain, are not transported through Latvian territory, the Saeima adopted an amendment to the Animal Feed Circulation Law in its final reading on Thursday, 24 September, according to the Saeima’s press office.
The Saeima adopted the amendments under urgent procedure.
Fees to be hiked on Russian grain transit, total ban to be considered September 17, 18:17
The amendment provides for the possibility of inspecting consignments of animal feed, including taking samples for laboratory testing to verify their origin. This is particularly important in cases where there are suspicions that the actual origin of a consignment does not match that stated in the accompanying documents, or that it may be linked to Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine, said Arvils Ašeradens (New Unity), Chair of the Saeima Committee on Economic Affairs,…

Taraneh and Romina Rahimi were charged with ‘waging war against God’ after joining protests against Tehran regime
The family of 21-year-old twins who have been sentenced respectively to death and decades in jail for protesting against the Iranian regime have appealed to the United Nations for help.
A formal “submission of information” relating to the case of Taraneh and Romina Rahimi has been submitted by British human right lawyers on their family’s behalf.
The move could lead to the UN’s human rights council opening talks with the Iranian regime about resolving the case if it is found to involve human rights violations.
